title: Digital Content Producer
description:
Apple Recruitment are recruiting for a Digital Content Producer on behalf of the NI Assembly.
This is a temporary contract initially until 30 th October 2026 with possibility of extension. The hourly
rate is £18.77 per hour.
Job Description:
Filming and editing video content for publication on the Northern Ireland Assembly's social
media channels, website and intranet.
Work as part of a team to film and edit material on events and engagements, at Parliament
Buildings and external venues.
On-air presentation and broadcasting for the Assembly's website, social media channels and
intranet.
Design and publish social media graphics, working with colleagues in the Communications
Office, to enhance the branding and messaging of the Assembly's Committee and public
engagement activities.
Monitoring mailboxes for content creation requests, completing work within agreed
deadlines.
Using knowledge of Assembly processes and Northern Ireland politics to generate ideas for
effective communication of corporate objectives.
Knowledge of regulatory compliance matters, such as GDPR and accessibility, to ensure that
all content meets these standards.
Maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders including MLAs, Assembly
Commission staff, officials from Executive departments and members of the public.
Managing information and records in accordance with established policies and statutory
requirements including the gathering of information and co-ordination of responses to
information requests including Freedom of Information requests.
Complying with all Assembly Commission's staff policies and procedures including Equal
Opportunities and Dignity at Work policies and procedures.
Carrying out other duties that the Assembly Commission reasonably requires of you.
If you wish to apply or would like more information, please email your CV in Microsoft word
format to Caroline by clicking on the link below by 10am on Thursday 20 th August 2026. You must
also include a bullet pointed synopsis at the top of your CV demonstrating how exactly you meet
the Essential Criteria below:
Essential Criteria:
Applicants for the post must have, by the closing date for application:
1. At least a primary degree, minimum 2.2 classification, in any subject.
Applications will be considered from applicants with formal qualifications of an equivalent or higher
standard to those stated.
AND
At least two years' experience in the criteria (a) to (d) below:
a) Regular and skilled use of camera equipment and video editing software for business needs;
b) Using graphic design software for social media and website use;
c) Promoting strategic messaging or corporate storytelling on social media platforms; and

d) Using analytics/insights to measure the impact of content on the web and/or social
channels.
OR
2. GCSE/GCE 'O' level passes at grades A to C in four subjects including English language.
Applications will be considered from applicants with relevant formal qualifications of an equivalent
or higher standard to those stated.
AND
Four years' experience in the criteria (a) to (d) above.
Further Details:
Hourly Rate based on £36,122 per annum, £ 18.77 per hour
ASAP until 30 th October 2026 with possibility of extension
Closing Date for CV's: 10am on Thursday 20 th August 2026
Date for informal discussion: Tuesday 25 th August via Teams
This area operates Hybrid working
If you wish to apply or would like more information, please email your CV in Microsoft word format
to Julie by clicking on the link below by 10am on Thursday 20 th August.
Applicants must ensure their CV is accurate and up to date. The CV should include your full
employment history inclusive of dates, all academic achievements and full personal contact details.
Please note only applicants that match this criteria can be considered for the role.
Apple Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. Apple
Recruitment Services is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: E-commerce & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Specialist

Belfast

Competitive Salary

Are you a creative, commercially minded digital marketer who gets excited about e-commerce, data, websites and creating exceptional customer experiences?

Our client is seeking an inspiring E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Specialist to join their growing team and play a key role in shaping the next stage of their digital journey.

Following significant investment in rebuilding and enhancing their e-commerce offering, they are now looking for a talented individual to take the platform to the next level, maximise its potential and drive meaningful commercial growth.

This is a hands-on, varied and commercially focused role combining e-commerce management, digital marketing, website optimisation, customer acquisition, content, social media and digital product development.

You will have the opportunity to influence the digital customer journey, identify new revenue opportunities and turn creative ideas into measurable commercial results.

The Role

As E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of the e-commerce and digital marketing activity across a portfolio of established brands.

The perfect candidate will be commercially sharp, analytically strong, technically confident and blessed with a creative eye for making things look great and work even better.

You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, using data, technology and creativity to improve the customer journey, grow online revenue and strengthen the organisation's digital presence.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver the e-commerce and digital marketing strategy across multiple brands.
- Drive online sales, customer acquisition and commercial growth through data-led marketing.
- Manage website content, landing pages, promotions, merchandising and UX.
- Ensure websites are technically optimised, mobile responsive, user-friendly and SEO compliant.
- Plan and deliver digital campaigns, promotions and content across relevant channels.
- Manage the digital marketing calendar and budget to maximise ROI.
- Monitor website and campaign performance, using analytics to identify improvements and growth opportunities.
- Create engaging blogs, digital content and social media campaigns to build brand awareness and engagement.
- Manage organic social media channels, engaging with customers, prospects and industry partners.
- Support the development of the e-commerce product portfolio using customer and market insights.
- Stay up to date with emerging digital trends, technologies and best practice.

Essential Criteria
- Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, E-commerce, Business or a related field.
- Minimum 3 years' experience in e-commerce and/or digital marketing.
- Experience with digital marketing automation, Google Ads and Google Analytics/GA4.
- Knowledge of web publishing, CMS platforms and SEO tools.
- Experience developing and delivering email marketing campaigns, ideally using Klaviyo.
- Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills.
- Excellent organisational and multitasking abilities, with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, commercially focused environment.

title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
Marketing Automation Specialist

Belfast (Hybrid)

35-45 K

Northern Ireland Global Semiconductor Business Marketing Automation / Salesforce / Pardot

Marketing expertise. Technical capability. Global impact.

Ready to take your marketing automation expertise into a genuinely global role?

A global leader in the semiconductor industry is looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist to join its global digital marketing team, working across North America, Europe and Asia.

Based in their growing Belfast team , this is a role for someone who knows marketing, understands the technology behind great automation and wants the freedom to keep learning, developing and making an impact.

You'll join an exceptional, collaborative and multicultural culture, working with specialists across Marketing, Sales, Digital, Web, Communications and Analytics, and you'll have real ownership.

The role

Sitting at the intersection of Marketing, Technology, Data and Sales, you'll help shape how global audiences are engaged, nurtured and converted.

Using Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), you'll build and optimise sophisticated marketing automation and nurture programmes, helping turn audience engagement into meaningful opportunities for the business.

You'll work closely with the Head of Global Digital Marketing and stakeholders around the world to understand what they need, challenge thinking and translate marketing requirements into scalable automation solutions.

You'll be responsible for:
- Building and optimising automated campaigns and nurture journeys using Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement.
- Creating segmentation, automation rules, dynamic content, lead scoring and data-routing processes.
- Developing personalised emails, forms and automated customer journeys.
- Managing the flow of Marketing Qualified Leads between Marketing and Sales.
- Using campaign, audience and funnel data to identify what's working and where performance can improve.
- Maintaining accurate data and alignment between marketing automation and Salesforce CRM.
- Managing HTML/CSS email templates, UTM tracking and campaign attribution.
- Troubleshooting automation, synchronisation, deliverability and data issues.
- Working globally across Sales, Digital Marketing, Web, Communications, Analytics and Operations.

What you'll bring

First and foremost, you're a marketer.

You understand audiences, customer journeys, lead nurturing and what effective B2 B marketing looks like. You also have the technical knowledge to turn that thinking into effective marketing automation.

We're looking for:
- 2+ years' hands-on experience with Pardot / Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement.
- Strong marketing automation, email marketing and lead-management expertise.
- Experience creating automated nurture journeys and workflows.
- Knowledge of audience segmentation, lead scoring and lead routing.
- A good understanding of Salesforce CRM and Marketing/Sales integration.
- HTML/CSS knowledge for email templates and experience with UTM/tracking.
- Experience with Power BI, Google Analytics or similar analytics tools.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- The ability to troubleshoot complex marketing automation issues.

Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Consultant certification is highly desirable.

Communication matters here

This is not a role where you'll sit behind a platform all day.
- You'll work with colleagues from different disciplines, countries and cultures, so you'll need to be an excellent communicator and relationship builder.
- You'll be confident speaking with Sales one minute and Digital, Web or Communications the next, understanding different priorities and bringing people together around the right solution.
- You'll be curious, collaborative and comfortable sharing your expertise while continuing to learn from those around you.

What do you get in return?
- A brilliant culture and a serious opportunity to grow.
- You'll become part of a global team where people share knowledge, different perspectives are valued and continuous learning is part of the culture.
- You'll work with talented specialists around the world, gain exposure across multiple areas of Marketing and Technology and have the opportunity to develop far beyond the boundaries of a traditional marketing automation role.

If you've built strong expertise in Pardot, Marketing Automation or Marketing Operations and you're ready for an environment that will challenge you, invest in your learning and give you global exposure, we'd like to hear from you.

Bring the expertise. Stay curious. Build what's next.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Marketing Ops
description:
Senior Marketing Data AnalystWolfspeed Marketing Analytics & Operations

Wolfspeed is looking for a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to help build the reporting, analytics and data foundations that will give the Marketing team a much clearer view of performance and business impact.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working on the technical side of data and reporting, particularly Power BI and SQL, while also being interested in how marketing data connects to customers, leads and sales pipeline.

You'll have the opportunity to bring together data from different systems, build meaningful dashboards and create a more joined-up view of marketing performance. The role will suit someone who likes solving problems, improving how things work and turning complex data into something the wider business can actually use.

What you'll be doingBuild and develop Power BI dashboards and reporting that give Marketing and Sales clear visibility of performance.

Use SQL to extract, analyse and work with data from multiple sources.

Bring together data from marketing, CRM and analytics platforms to create a more complete picture of the customer journey.

Help establish reporting around campaign performance, conversion, leads, opportunities, pipeline and marketing ROI.

Improve understanding of how marketing activity contributes to the sales pipeline and wider business results.

Develop practical approaches to attribution and marketing performance measurement.

Work with stakeholders to understand what they actually need from reporting and turn this into useful dashboards and insights.

Help improve data quality, consistency and reporting processes across the marketing environment.

Identify opportunities to improve the way marketing data is captured, connected and reported.

Work across different technologies and systems, helping create a scalable marketing reporting and operations framework.

What we're looking for The technical/data capability is the key requirement for this role.

You'll need strong hands-on experience with:

Power BI - building dashboards and reporting that can be used by business stakeholders.

SQL - working confidently with data, querying multiple sources and getting to the detail behind the numbers.

Data analysis and working with large and/or multiple datasets.

Turning technical analysis into clear insights and recommendations for non-technical audiences.

We're also looking for someone who is naturally curious, analytical and proactive - someone who can look at a problem, work out what the business needs and build a practical solution rather than waiting for a perfectly defined brief.

Marketing technology experience - desirable, not essentialExperience within marketing analytics or marketing operations would be a strong advantage, particularly exposure to:

Salesforce

Pardot / marketing automation

Google Analytics / GA4

Adobe Analytics

Marketing attribution and funnel reporting

CRM and marketing data integration

However, we are open on industry background and specific marketing platforms. You don't need to have worked in a semiconductor or manufacturing environment, and we would consider candidates who have strong technical/data experience but have worked with different CRM, marketing automation or analytics technologies.

What matters is that you can demonstrate an ability to understand systems, work with data and build reporting that solves real business problems.

Why this role?This is an opportunity to build something rather than simply inherit an established reporting function.

You'll play an important role in creating a single, trusted view of marketing performance, helping the business understand where marketing investment is working and how it is contributing to pipeline.

Over time, there is scope for the role to develop into a broader Marketing Operations / Analytics leadership position, making this a particularly good opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership and grow with the function.

To speak in absolute confidence about this opportunity please send an up-to-date CV via the link provided or contact Senior Recruitment Consultant Stuart Kennedy at MCS Group on or .

Even if this position is not right for you, we may have others that are. Please visit MCS Group to view a wide selection of our current jobs.

title: UX / Product Research & Strategy Lead (VP)
description:
UX / Product Research & Strategy Lead (VP)

Discover your future at Citi

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Job Overview

Great employee experiences don't happen by accident - they're designed. At Citi, we believe that the tools people use every day at work should be just as intuitive, seamless, and delightful as the best consumer apps out there.

Our UX team is on a mission to transform our Human Resources apps and systems - from onboarding and benefits to performance and beyond - turning friction into flow and complexity into clarity.

If you're passionate about putting people first, obsessed with crafting digital experiences that genuinely make life easier, and excited by the idea that great design can elevate the everyday moments of someone's working world, then this is the role for you.

The Role

As a UX / Product Research & Strategy Lead you'll drive the strategic direction of the experience, owning the research programme that underpins product vision and direction. Building on all the skills of a Senior UX Researcher, your focus extends beyond individual research studies to shaping the north star for the experience and ensuring that research and strategy are deeply embedded in how product decisions are made. You'll lead the full range of research needed to understand users, markets, and the competitive landscape, and will collaborate directly with senior stakeholders to translate those insights into a clear, compelling experience strategy.

Responsibilities
- Take direct ownership of defining and evolving the experience north star - working with product, design, and business leadership to articulate a clear, evidence-based vision for where the experience needs to go and why
- Lead the development of the experience strategy, translating research insights, market intelligence, and business goals into actionable strategic direction that guides product roadmaps and design priorities
- Drive senior stakeholder alignment around the experience vision, facilitating workshops and strategy sessions that bring together diverse perspectives and build consensus around user-centred outcomes
- Establish and lead a programme of research and strategic discovery that continuously informs and challenges the north star, ensuring it remains grounded in real user needs and evolving business context
- Lead a wide variety of research including user interviews, co-creation, journey mapping, usability and concept tests and surveys, ensuring that actionable results are delivered and shared
- Design and execute research studies that follow research best practices and methodologies
- Present and communicate research results and recommendations to stakeholder teams and the larger organization when needed
- Collaborate and share research findings and insights across the organization
- Provide guidance and rigor around research methodologies and best practices
- Define relevant metrics for benchmarking and measurement of journeys
- Integrate research insights with quantitative data to inform deep understanding of client journeys as well as data-driven prioritization
- Bring innovative approaches and creative thinking to scoping primary research with populations that may be challenging to recruit
- Understand existing and planned Citi infrastructure and projects, and work on solutions that can be implemented in a timely manner to make measurable impact
- Mentor user researchers and designers doing research to grow and scale research capabilities
- Collaborate with research and design leadership to identify new tools and/or process improvements that drive better alignment and compliance with design systems
- Apply a positive and constructive attitude to all feedback
- Work closely with UX Designers to ensure they have all the details they need to generate detailed UX designs
- Keep up to date with the latest UX practices, innovations, and tools
- Help to support new UX starters in the team
- Participate in the wider UX community of practice

Required Skills, Experience and Competencies
- Significant relevant UX Research experience, with demonstrable experience in a strategic or research leadership capacity
- Extensive hands-on experience leading qualitative and quantitative UX research in a product design environment across the Design Thinking stages
- Proven track record of translating research into strategic recommendations that have directly influenced product direction, roadmaps, or north star vision
- Experience facilitating senior stakeholder workshops and strategy sessions to build alignment around experience direction
- Ability to lead workshops relating to UX Research both in-person & remote
- Creative problem solver comfortable dealing with uncertainty and ambiguity at a strategic level
- Self-starter with the ability to define goals, strategies, and research programmes with limited direction
- Able to combine strategic thinking with pragmatism without sacrificing quality
- Proactive and positive attitude, with strong attention to detail & analytical skills
- Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including confident presentation to senior leadership
- Significant experience working with senior stakeholders, product managers, and engineers
- Familiarity with research tools e.g. UserZoom, Dovetail, EnjoyHQ, Qualtrics
- Bachelor's/University degree

Desirable Skills, Experience and Competencies
- Experience in e-commerce/Internet/mobile space
- Experience with agile methodology
- Financial services industry and commercial banking experience
- Experience with service design, systems thinking, or experience strategy frameworks
- Master's degree

Education:
- Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred
- At least one formal UX Qualification

What we'll provide you

By joining Citi, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:
- 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
- A discretional annual performance related bonus
- Private Medical Care & Life Insurance
- Employee Assistance Program
- Pension Plan
- Paid Parental Leave
- Special discounts for employees, family, and friends
- Access to an array of learning and development resources

For further information and to submit your application, click the apply icon.

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self, every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay and empowered to thrive.

title: Head of Engagement and Participation
description:
Head of Engagement and Participation

Accountable to: Accountable through the interim collective leadership arrangements agreed by Council, with day-to-day line management provided by a Council-appointed lead.

Location: The Corrymeela Centre, Ballycastle and Belfast Office, with flexibility required

We also rent a room in Belfast for staff to work from/Council to meet in:

Skainos Centre
239 Newtownards Road
Belfast BT4 1 AF

Role Status: Member of the Senior Management Team (SMT)

Contract: 12-month Fixed Term contract commencing January 2027 until December 2027 (subject to review)

Introduction

Corrymeela is Northern Ireland's oldest peace and reconciliation community. Founded in 1965, by the Reverend Ray Davey, we bring people together across religious, political, cultural and social differences to build understanding, strengthen relationships and support reconciliation.

Our community of members, staff and volunteers and are drawn from a wide range of backgrounds and faith traditions and work together to contribute towards building a more cohesive and hope-filled society for everyone.

The Head of Engagement and Participation is a member of the Senior Management Team and will help strengthen Corrymeela's collective leadership model by enabling meaningful participation, shared stewardship, clear communication and deeper connection across members, staff, volunteers, supporters and partners. They will represent Corrymeela with integrity and confidence, in a manner that honours its Christian foundation and participate in the creation of its vision for the future

Overall Purpose

As a member of the SMT, to collaboratively develop and deliver the strategy for the whole organisation, upholding the Corrymeela Community Charter and contributing to the collective leadership, organisational health and future readiness of Corrymeela.

The Head of Engagement and Participation has particular responsibility for strengthening participation, volunteering, membership engagement, communications, supporter and donor engagement, contributing to safeguarding arrangements, and coordinating worship and spiritual life, so that Corrymeela can live more fully into its mission and philosophy of "Be the Change."

Key Responsibilities

1. Participation, Membership and Shared Stewardship
- Lead approaches that strengthen participation, belonging and contribution across members, volunteers, staff, Council, partners and supporters.
- Develop ways for members and others to contribute their gifts, experience and leadership.
- Create mechanisms for listening, consultation, feedback and dialogue across the Community.

2. Collective Leadership and Organisational Stewardship
- Collaborate with SMT colleagues and Council to develop, deliver and report on strategic priorities, annual operating plans and budgets.
- Share responsibility for organisational leadership, culture, wellbeing, strategic planning, sustainability, risk management and stakeholder relationships.
- Model cross-team collaboration, shared stewardship and healthy participation.
- Contribute to decision-making arrangements that clarify responsibility, participation and accountability.
- Act as an ambassador for Corrymeela.

3. Volunteering and Volunteer Development
- Provide strategic leadership for volunteering and volunteer development.
- Strengthen volunteer recruitment, induction, support, communication, development and recognition.
- Ensure volunteering is safe, purposeful and aligned with safeguarding practice and organisational needs.

4. Communications and Engagement
- Lead internal and external communications in partnership with Communications Manager.
- Oversee digital communications, website content, social media engagement and audience development strategies.
- Ensure communications strengthen trust, clarity, participation and shared purpose.
- Oversee communications planning, channels, messaging and content.
- Support public engagement and storytelling aligned with Corrymeela's mission.

5. Supporter, Donor and Relationship Engagement
- Lead the organisation's approach to supporter and donor engagement, working in partnership with the Fundraising Manager
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with statutory, community, faith organisations, academic and peacebuilding partners.
- Support donor and supporter engagement in partnership with the Fundraising Manager, nurturing relationships that strengthen long-term sustainability.
- Nurture relationships with supporters, donors, members and friends of Corrymeela.

6. Worship, Spiritual Life and Community Rhythms
- Coordinate a small team of members to look after worship, prayer, theological reflection and spiritual life.
- Support gatherings, events and rhythms that express Corrymeela's Christian identity and peacebuilding vocation.
- Encourage shared leadership in worship and spiritual life.

7. Safeguarding

Contribute to the effective implementation of safeguarding arrangements across Corrymeela, ensuring policies, training, reporting requirements and safe practice are understood and embedded within areas of responsibility.

Promote a safe and respectful culture across the organisation.

8. Staff and Team Leadership
- Lead relevant staff and functional areas within the engagement and participation portfolio.
- Manage performance, supervision and appraisal processes.
- Support collaboration across organisational teams.
- Champion equality, diversity, inclusion and belonging across all aspects of community life.

9. Planning, Reporting and Accountability
- Develop operational plans and budgets.
- Monitor progress, risks and impact.
- Ensure compliance with GDPR, safeguarding and organisational policies.
- Contribute to organisational learning and future planning.

10. Other Duties
- Undertake other reasonable duties as a member of the SMT.
- Participate in ongoing review and development of the role in response to organisational needs.

Flexible Work Patterns

It is the nature of the work of Corrymeela that tasks and responsibilities are unpredictable and varied. All staff are required to work in a flexible way to meet the needs of the organisation. This will include evening and weekend working from time to time.

Statement on Confidentiality

It is in the nature of the work of Corrymeela that staff become aware of information that will be sensitive and/or confidential. It is crucial that this information is maintained in strictest confidence, within the context of Corrymeela's policies and procedures, and that failure to do so will be viewed as gross misconduct and will be subject to the appropriate level of the disciplinary procedures.

Safeguarding Policy

We require all staff and volunteers to work according to Corrymeela's Safeguarding Policy. Where appropriate, offers of employment are subject to a check by AccessNI. A copy of the AccessNI Code of Practice is available on request.

Employment of Ex-offenders

Corrymeela has a policy on the recruitment of ex-offenders. A criminal record will not necessarily debar anyone from being offered employment.

General Responsibilities
- Members of staff are expected at all times to provide the appropriate service and to treat those with whom they come into contact with, in a courteous and respectful manner.
- All staff must comply with the Corrymeela Community No Smoking Policy on Corrymeela premises and while on duty for the charity.
- All duties are carried out in compliance with Corrymeela's Health and Safety Policy and Statutory requirements.
- The Corrymeela Community is an Equal Opportunities Employer. You are required to adhere to Corrymeela's Equal Opportunities Policy throughout the course of employment. Staff should be familiar with the Corrymeela Community Charter.
- To ensure the ongoing confidence of the public in the staff of Corrymeela Community, staff must ensure they maintain the high standards of personal accountability.

Further Information

Further information regarding entitlements and staff policies will be found in a comprehensive staff handbook, presented to staff upon commencement of employment.

How to Apply and Closing Date

Applicants can obtain an application form by emailing . Completed application forms should be returned to before 5.00pm on Monday 28th September 2026.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Lisburn

Competitive Salary

MCS are delighted to share an exciting opportunity for an experienced Marketing Executive to join a creative, dynamic and innovative Marketing team.

The role offers the opportunity to work across the full marketing mix, from traditional marketing campaigns and new product launches through to digital marketing, creative content and customer targeting.

Key Responsibilities

- Create, develop and implement marketing campaigns supporting product brands and services.
- Plan, design and implement exhibitions, events and other promotional activities.
- Produce, proofread and manage marketing materials, technical information and customer communications.

- Create and manage website content and maintain social media profiles.
- Conduct market research and monitor direct and indirect market influences.

- Minimum 2 years' experience in a similar marketing role.
- Demonstrable experience managing multiple marketing projects and working to deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be a creative and organised marketing professional with strong communication skills and excellent attention to detail. The ability to manage multiple projects, work collaboratively across departments and deliver high-quality marketing activity within deadlines is essential.
